market_view: VIX 16.5, calm after a 9% fall over 5 days; risk assets bounced hard (semis +5.6% on the day, copper miners +5-8%) while WTI dropped 5.7% with no named cause. Earnings-season noise dominates the headlines.

oil_gas.reasoning: WTI -5.7% on the day has no cause in the headlines; XOM only -0.7%. Shell buyback and an EPD dividend raise are not XOM catalysts. A driver move already happened and is priced in.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold +1.5% and NEM +2.5% have no Fed, dollar or NEM headline. The Warsh 'fewer FOMC meetings' piece is opinion, not a decision. Gold is 22% below its high; trend is not a reason.

chips.catalyst: none qualifying: Amazon capex raised to $220B (The Motley Fool) is positive for AI demand but was reported with the earnings and the sector already jumped 5.6%; AMD fell 9% after hours on gross-margin guidance
chips.reasoning: AI capex news is mostly priced after a +8.7% five-day sector run, and the AMD margin reaction cuts the other way. No NVDA-specific catalyst.

pharma.reasoning: LLY -8.6% over 5 days with no LLY headline; no trial, regulator or pricing news for the family. A dip without a cause is not a catalyst.

copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper +1.6% and FCX +5.8% have no supply or China headline. Bloom Energy and data-center power articles are not uranium or copper catalysts. A move that already happened is priced in.

would_change_my_mind: A leader-specific headline: a supply shock or OPEC+ decision for XOM, a Fed or dollar shift for NEM, an export-rule change or NVDA guidance for chips, an LLY trial or regulator result, or a copper supply outage for FCX.

handoff.what_changed: Five days since the last note (07-31). VIX eased to 16.5; semis rose a further 5.6% on the day, copper miners ran again, WTI fell 5.7% and LLY slid to 9.7% below its high. Headlines held earnings-season news (Amazon capex $220B, AMD margin miss, Meta, Apple, SpaceX) but no leader-specific catalyst.

oil_gas.why: WTI whipsaw again has no named cause and there is no XOM or OPEC+ headline.

gold_miners.why: Gold and NEM bounce has no Fed, dollar or NEM catalyst.

chips.why: Amazon capex raise is already in a sector up 8.7% in five days; AMD margin reaction is mixed; no NVDA catalyst.

pharma.why: LLY decline over five days has no LLY news.

copper_uranium.why: FCX and copper strength has no supply or demand headline.
